topic.title: Accessing
topic.shortdesc: How to access after your administrator provides the server URL.

body.p: Your organization administrator must install and configure the server before you can access it.
body.note: If you are the organization administrator, see the Server Administrator Guide for details.
body.p: Once the administrator sets up the server, they give you the URL you need to access . This address represents the platform main page.
If you do not have the address, contact your server administrator to obtain it.
When you open the platform main page in your browser, you have options to sign up for a new account or log in to an existing one.
body.note: Bookmark the platform main page address in your browser for quick future access.
